analysis.title: Clarivate (CLVT): 3Q First Take: Organic growth and margins beat as the LS&H divestiture is completed
key_insights: GS expects a mixed investor reaction to Clarivate's 3Q 2026 release. Organic revenue growth, EBITDA margin and EPS beat consensus, but the full-year outlook was cut to reflect the completed LS&H divestiture.

3Q organic revenue rose 0.4% y/y, versus a 1.5% decline in 2Q. GS had estimated -0.2% and FactSet consensus was -0.9%. Subscription revenue grew 1.5% and re-occurring revenue grew 0.7%, while transactional revenue fell 12.4%.
Transactional revenue declined across all segments, partly because customers are migrating to subscription offerings.
By segment, Academia & Government organic revenue rose 0.9% y/y and Intellectual Property organic revenue fell 0.4%.
Organic ACV grew 1.8% y/y in 3Q, up 30 bps from the prior quarter.
EBITDA margin expanded 340 bps y/y to 45.3%, helped by favorable revenue mix and cost discipline. That compares with GS at 43.0% and consensus at 43.1%.

Reported revenue from continuing operations was $481.6mn, down 9.2% y/y, mostly from inorganic disposals. GS and consensus estimates still included LS&H, so the reported figures are not directly comparable to them.
2026 guidance was reset for the divestiture. Revenue is now $1,965-1,985mn, EBITDA $865-885mn and EPS $0.73-0.77. Organic ACV growth is 1.75-2.25% and recurring organic revenue growth is 1.0-1.5%.
GS expects negative consensus revisions to revenue and EBITDA and stable consensus EPS after the guidance reset.

GS is Neutral with a $2.60 12-month price target, 56.6% above the $1.66 close on 2 Nov 2026. The target uses 5.00x NTM + 1YR EBITDA, a discount to the Info Services peer median because of lower organic growth, partly offset by higher margins.

Call focus areas GS expects: the impact of the LS&H divestiture, when transactional revenue returns to positive growth, client purchasing behavior and sales cycles in an uncertain macro backdrop, and Value Creation Plan initiatives.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps Neutral and the $2.60 target (unchanged from 30-Jul-26) after an organic growth, margin and EPS beat offset by a lower outlook from the LS&H divestiture. The stock closed at $1.66 on 2 Nov 2026.

earnings_insights: CLVT 3Q 2026 reported (continuing operations): revenue $481.6mn vs GS estimate $583.5mn and FactSet consensus $566.8mn. The estimates include LS&H, so the comparison is not like-for-like.
CLVT 3Q 2026 reported organic revenue growth +0.4% y/y vs GS estimate -0.2% and FactSet consensus -0.9%, a beat.
CLVT 3Q 2026 reported EBITDA $218.2mn, margin 45.3%, vs GS estimate margin 43.0% and FactSet consensus margin 43.1%. The dollar EBITDA estimates ($250.9mn GS, $244.2mn consensus) include LS&H.
CLVT 3Q 2026 reported EPS $0.21 vs GS estimate $0.19 and FactSet consensus $0.18, a beat.

Updated 2026 guidance (company, post-LS&H): revenue $1,965-1,985mn (prior $2,300-2,420mn), EBITDA $865-885mn (prior $980-1,040mn), EBITDA margin 44.3% at the midpoint (prior 42.8%), EPS $0.73-0.77 (prior $0.70-0.80).
The company guides 2026 organic ACV growth of 1.75-2.25% (prior 2-3%) and recurring organic revenue growth of 1.0-1.5% (prior 0.75-2.25%).

Pre-print GS 2026 estimates were revenue $2,346mn, EBITDA $1,002mn (42.7% margin) and EPS $0.77. FactSet consensus before the print was revenue $2,295mn, EBITDA $978mn (42.6% margin) and EPS $0.74. Both include LS&H.
risk_factors: Direct and indirect impact from reduced US government spending
Volatility and underperformance in transactional and reoccurring revenue
Rising input costs and competitive pressures
Weaker-than-expected product offering or an ineffective go-to-market strategy
Upside risks: product innovation, stronger pricing, cross-selling and upselling, streamlined operations and potential portfolio rationalization

tension_points.bull_case: 3Q organic revenue growth turned positive at +0.4% against consensus of -0.9%, EBITDA margin rose 340 bps to 45.3%, and EPS of $0.21 beat consensus of $0.18.
tension_points.bear_case: Full-year revenue, EBITDA, organic ACV and recurring organic revenue guidance were all lowered, GS expects negative consensus revisions to revenue and EBITDA, and transactional revenue still fell 12.4%.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Transactional revenue failing to inflect to positive growth, which GS names as an earnings call focus.

theme_stances.key_argument: Beats on organic growth, margin and EPS are offset by a lower full-year outlook from the LS&H divestiture, so GS expects a mixed reaction.
theme_stances.evidence: organic revenue growth, EBITDA margins and EPS outperforming consensus expectations
